In the first guide for readers passionate about love "and" food, Malouf, comedian and TV food personality, combines two of life's most primal drives. "Booty Food" is filled with laugh-out-loud advice about dating, sex, and more than 70 delicious yet user-friendly recipes designed to complement each stage of a long-lasting love affair. Photos
